title: National Jail Census Series
description:
Investigator(s): Bureau of Justice Statistics
The National Jail Census was conducted by the U.S. 
Census Bureau for the Bureau of Justice Statistics. Excluded from the 
census were federal- or state-administered facilities, including the 
combined jail-prison systems in Alaska, Connecticut, Delaware, Hawaii, 
Rhode Island, and Vermont. Data include jail population by reason being 
held, age (juvenile or adult) and sex, maximum sentence that can be 
served in the facility, available services, type of security available, 
facility capacity, age, construction and renovation of the facility, 
employment, and operating expenditures.Years Produced: 
Every 5 years
